results.rationale: Both hypotheses are fully uncertain (u=1, b=d=0), so ranking reduces to base-rate plausibility a; B's much higher a (0.0293 vs 0.00055) gives it a far larger expected support, so B is favored.

Both are equally 'refuted' with identical b/d/u, differing only in mechanism base rate; B's mechanism (taurid-stream-encounter, a=0.0180) outweighs A's (gamma-ray-ionization, a=0.0110), so B is modestly favored.
A carries full uncertainty but a much higher base rate (0.0110) than B, which also suffers partial disbelief (d≈0.50) on top of a tiny base rate (0.00055), yielding A a far larger expected value.
Both are fully uncertain with no belief/disbelief; comparing base rates alone, B's mechanism (taurid-stream-encounter, a=0.0180) exceeds A's (gamma-ray-ionization, a=0.0110), slightly favoring B.
